card.name: Start of long medical condition names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical term that is split into parts, such as Micro, Hyp, Poly or My. It appears at the start of a condition or adverse reaction name, often after a section number or comma.

modes.label: Hyp- terms
modes.description: The start of conditions beginning with Hyp, such as hypothyroidism, hypomagnesemia, hypopyon or hypersensitivity.

modes.label: Other opening pieces
modes.description: Opening pieces like Micro, Poly or My at the start of a disease name.
modes.example: Discontinue ACTEMRA<< Poly>>articular and Systemic Juvenile Id

card.writes: It promotes mostly unrelated multilingual tokens, so it has no clear output effect beyond continuing a long word.
card.plain: It fires on the first chunk of a long medical word like hypothyroidism or microscopic, when the word is not yet complete.
